name: Neo Angband recommended mods
about: The game's Recommended mods list, as repository addresses and nothing else. Every fact about a mod, such as its name, what it does, which versions exist and which builds of the game it works with, comes from that mod's own repository when the game looks it up. "mods" holds the first-party mods. "community" holds mods by other authors, added after their release passed the listing checks in docs/MODS.md; a listing is not an endorsement, a code review or a security audit, and a community mod installs and updates as a third-party mod, behind the player's Allow third-party mods switch. Anyone can point the game at their own list of the same shape, or install a single repository by URL, without going through here.
